I'd say there aren't any teams here, but there are a few categories to put people in.

Most users are regular folks with opinions and links and stupid internet jokes.

Then there are the shills - accounts created to promote or pretend to promote controversial or outlandish material in order to try and derail the thread or even the whole site. Spammers like Amalek and the Manhood 101 robots kind of fall under this category too.

The hate groups tend to keep to themselves and you only really see that stuff if you go to their subs or browse /all/new and catch it as it comes.

It's also worth noting there's a fair number of sock puppets from the other site - they tend to post complaints about how racist or sexist or whatever-ist Voat happens to be at the moment. Some people think they are trying to turn Voat into the safe-space hugbox that seems to be the way of a lot of websites these days. But I think they're just mad about Voat taking members and try to scare people away. Also worth noting many of the shills do this too.

There are some people who are also making multiple accounts here to try and fake support for particular causes or ideas. They generally get spotted pretty quickly, since the folks doing that sort of thing are usually doing so because of unpopular opinions and people suck at pretending to be other people.
